name: treg
description: OpenRouter for agent tools. Join community here: https://discord.gg/6mQYYfFMAn
one_liner: A single billing account and API key that lets an AI agent call thousands of paid data and tool services — finding someone's email, checking backlinks — and pay per use, instead of signing up for dozens of separate $100-a-month subscriptions.
buyer: A solo developer or small agency building AI agents who needs occasional access to expensive tools (SEO data, people-lookup, scraping) without paying for a full subscription to each provider.
business_use_cases: A lead-gen agency's agent looks up a prospect's email and company info per-call through treg instead of paying for a $59/seat Apollo subscription nobody else on the team uses.
A solo SEO consultant's agent checks backlink data for a client site once a month via treg instead of paying $139/month for Semrush access.
An indie hacker building an AI research agent taps treg's catalog for trend and social data without integrating and paying for a dozen separate APIs.

money_ideas.idea: treg itself is the business model here: a markup on per-call pricing across its catalog of 3,000+ endpoints, billed against team balances.
Build a niche vertical agent (e.g. a 'competitor intelligence bot') that resells treg-powered lookups bundled into a simple monthly report.

steal_this: Build a tiny Telegram bot this weekend that takes a company name and returns a one-page competitor snapshot (backlinks, socials, hiring signals) using treg calls billed per request.
